limitations: A seven-day observation cannot be completed before seven real days have elapsed.
The gate remains partial until 672 clean production samples span at least seven days and the real-browser role-change scenario passes.
The optional GitHub observer is manual-only because the account reported failed payments or a spending-limit block; this does not affect the Cloudflare-native ledger.
